answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 32744 Country: Pakistan Title: inheritance of sister Question: My sister had following two daughters Husband Mother five brothers two sisters Her husband had another wife from whom he had a son and one daugter. Who will be entitled to inheritence. Answer ID: 32744 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1017/616/L=1432) After paying all the due rights preceding inheritance, the property and wealth of your sister shall be divided into 13 shares. Her husband shall get 3 shares, her mother 2 shares while both the daughters 4-4 shares each. Brothers and sisters shall get nothing. The second wife of husband and her children do not have any share in the property of your sister; because they are not heir. The detail is as follows: Detail: Husband: 1x3 = 3 Mother: 1x2 = 2 Daughter: 2x4 = 8 Brothers: 00 Sisters: 00 Total: 13, Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
